name: Location Map Viewer
tagline: View your GPX, KML, and KMZ tracks on a map
description:
Location Map Viewer is a simple Android app for opening and viewing location files, GPX, KML, and KMZ, right on a map. Instead of needing a full desktop GIS program, you can just tap a file and see your hiking track, saved waypoints, or trip route laid out visually.

It's a handy little tool for anyone who works with location data from other apps or devices and just wants a quick way to look at it.
